rationale: The agent did not perform the requested refund to the credit card as per the user's demand. Instead, the agent stated that the more expensive tablet would be refunded to a gift card, which contradicts the user's request. Moreover, the standard policy stipulates that the agent should confirm every order-changing action with the user before proceeding, but in this case, it appears that confirmation was not obtained before the refund actions were executed. Therefore, the agent failed to fulfill the user's request in accordance with policy.
